claims.content: To manage track identity classification by exchanging track identity data and resolving differences in Environment/Category, Identity, and Exercise Indicator for tracks.

goal.raw_text: To manage track identity classification by exchanging track identity data and resolving differences in Environment/Category, Identity, and Exercise Indicator for tracks.

claims.content: C2 JU
A track report has the PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator set to value 1.
The new identity is Friend.
The locally held identity is not Hostile.
A C2 JU receives a track report with the PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator set to value 1 that contains changes in Environment/Category, Identity, or Exercise Indicator.

trigger.raw_text: A C2 JU receives a track report with the PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator set to value 1 that contains changes in Environment/Category, Identity, or Exercise Indicator.

claims.content: C2 JU exchanges track identity as defined in paragraph 4.4.2.1.
C2 JU reports the most current IFF/SIF data.

C2 JU reports the PPLI IFF/SIF Indicator in the J3 message as value 2 if all IFF/SIF nonzero mode codes were obtained from or are the same as the codes received in the J2 message for the subject TN; otherwise as value 1 if the Mode II code was obtained from or is the same as the Mode II code received in the J2 message; otherwise as value 0.

1. At step 0, if a track report with the PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator set to value 1 contains changes in Environment/Category, Identity, or Exercise Indicator, a C2 JU may elect to accept, automatically, the changes, provided the new identity is Friend and the locally held identity is not Hostile.

2. At step 0, when the PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator is set to value 1, it may be displayed to operators to give an extra measure of confidence in the track identification data being reported.

3. At step 2, if all IFF/SIF nonzero mode codes were obtained from or are the same as the codes received in the J2 message for the subject TN, the PPLI IFF/SIF Indicator in the J3 message shall be reported as value 2.
4. At step 2, if the Mode II code was obtained from or is the same as the Mode II code received in the J2 message, the PPLI IFF/SIF Indicator shall be reported as value 1.
5. At step 2, otherwise, the PPLI IFF/SIF Indicator shall be reported as value 0.

1. At the automatic acceptance decision, if the new identity is not Friend or the locally held identity is Hostile, the condition for a C2 JU to elect automatic acceptance of changes in Environment/Category, Identity, or Exercise Indicator is not met. EXIT: automatic acceptance is not performed.
Track identity as defined in paragraph 4.4.2.1 is exchanged.
The most current IFF/SIF data is reported.
If all IFF/SIF nonzero mode codes were obtained from or are the same as the codes received in the J2 message for the subject TN, the PPLI IFF/SIF Indicator in the J3 message is reported as value 2.
Otherwise, if the Mode II code was obtained from or is the same as the Mode II code received in the J2 message, the PPLI IFF/SIF Indicator is reported as value 1.
Otherwise, the PPLI IFF/SIF Indicator is reported as value 0.

If the C2 JU elects automatic acceptance and the new identity is Friend while the locally held identity is not Hostile, changes in Environment/Category, Identity, or Exercise Indicator received in a track report with the PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator set to value 1 are accepted automatically.
